title: AI Writes More PRs. Who Validates Them? — Ali-Reza Adl-Tabatabai, Sonar
talk_summary: Sonar's PR-validation agent automates the full validation phase (review, CI-failure triage, autofix, auto-merge) with a custom agent harness and LLM proxy tuned for token cost and precision. The key transferable ideas are trust-gated automation levels, flaky-test detection/retry, and combining agents with program analysis.

takeaways.what_they_do: Users progressively unlock automation: review-only, then blocking merges on findings, then autofix loops, then rule-based auto-approve/merge, as trust in review accuracy grows.
takeaways.evidence_quote: first they get reviews and they're happy with... then they give teeth to the agent by allowing it to start blocking the PRs

takeaways.what_they_do: Agent analyzes CI failures, summarizes root causes, specifically identifies flaky tests, and can auto-retry them via rules.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's really good at catching flaky tests. And you can even set up rules that automatically retry flaky tests

takeaways.what_they_do: Agent can be told to loop fixing its own review findings and CI failures until the PR is green, rather than one-shot review.
takeaways.evidence_quote: automatically loop until all the fish issues have been fixed in your PR and you have a green PR ready to merge

takeaways.technique: Custom harness tuned for fixed per-PR price
takeaways.what_they_do: They built their own agent harness to optimize token cost, precision, and coverage, enabling a guaranteed fixed price per PR.
takeaways.evidence_quote: having our own agent harness has really allowed us to optimize specifically for the validation use case... guarantee outcomes at a fixed PR price

takeaways.what_they_do: Combine agentic review with static analysis (taint, data-flow, control-flow, SCA) to raise precision and coverage.
takeaways.evidence_quote: combining an agentic approach to validation with program analysis... much better precision, much better coverage at a really great price point

takeaways.technique: LLM proxy with routing and failover
takeaways.what_they_do: An LLM proxy handles routing across models and failover, decoupled from the agent harness.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we also have an NLM proxy that handles the routing across different models as well as things like failover
